predictor.notes: Best-effort monotone predictor, not a uniquely identified exact reconstruction. It reproduces the exact approved/export prices of 68387 pence at quantity 50 and 127037 pence at quantity 200, and matches all 92 rounded responses after applying their 100000-pence rounding. Adjacent probes established rounding transitions between quantities 2/3 and 326/327. The segment boundary and tail curvature are modeling choices, not observed tariff boundaries. Exact recovery elsewhere is underdetermined: alternative monotone piecewise models matching every response predict 150091 versus 249695 pence at quantity 1000. Unobserved quantities remain unverified, and additional within-bin structure cannot be excluded. Used 96 business requests and 10 REA operations, observing 91 distinct quantities.
